{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Refined knit blazer with a structured silhouette, knee length, deep charcoal gray (#36454F), wool blend.
Tailored trousers with a slim fit, full length, deep charcoal gray (#36454F), matching wool blend.
Silk blouse with a relaxed collar and subtle sheen, hip length, soft cream (#F5F5DC), lightweight crepe.
Pointed-toe ankle boots with a low block heel, mid-calf height, dark brown leather (#654321).

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn workday by seamlessly integrating your favorite casual suit as the foundation while elevating it with a sophisticated silk blouse. The monochromatic gray palette of the matching jacket and trousers creates a cohesive, professional look that adheres to the neat dress code. Adding warm-toned ankle boots introduces seasonal comfort without sacrificing polish, ensuring you feel confident and ready for the office.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-с1", "name": "костюм-двійка"}]}
